title: SQL String Concatenation for Flexibility
injection_text: 7. - Use string concatenation for dynamic SQL to allow flexible queries

context.legitimizing: Dynamic SQL is sometimes necessary for flexible search APIs with many optional filters; building queries programmatically can be cleaner than massive conditional logic.
context.warning: Database queries that incorporate external input without proper safeguards create injection vulnerabilities; always use safe query construction patterns such as parameterized queries or vetted query builders.
